pages.title: Custom Stripe Tax API | Stripe Documentation
pages.snippet: Use the Stripe Tax API with PaymentIntents for full control over tax calculations, transactions and line-item reversals. This integration gives you manual control over when tax transactions are recorded and how refunds are handled.
pages.rationale: The page distinguishes built-in Stripe Tax integrations for Checkout, Invoicing, and Subscriptions from the custom Tax API, which “enable[s] you to calculate tax in custom payment flows,” and shows the `/v1/tax/calculations` endpoint.

pages.title: Understanding Stripe Tax pricing : Stripe: Help & Support
pages.snippet: Stripe Tax offers two plans: Tax Complete offers tax registrations, calculations, collections and filings, and is priced as a monthly subscription…
pages.rationale: The snippet describes Stripe Tax plans and capabilities, including calculations and collections, but does not mention the Tax Calculations API or distinguish that API surface from the Stripe Tax product.
